📌 IMPORTANT GUIDE: HOW TO TAKE PROFIT FROM BOT SIGNALS

Friends, let's break it down step by step — specifically profit. Nothing complicated, but order matters.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅ WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE READY IN ADVANCE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖥 HOW IT WORKS IN PRACTICE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Open your browser with your trading platform.
Next to it — desktop Telegram with the signal group.

A signal comes in.
👉 Either click the contract button — it copies, you paste it into the platform — the chart opens.
👉 Or simpler: click the platform button in the post — the coin's chart opens immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💰 STRATEGY #1: TAKE-PROFIT AND STOP-LOSS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 Take-Profit = 100% (that is, growth to 2x)
Entered with 1 SOL — grew to 2 SOL → close the trade, take the profit.

🛑 Stop-Loss = 30%
Price dropped 30% → close, take the remaining 70%.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💎 STRATEGY #2: FOR THOSE WHO WANT MORE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When profit hits 2x:
✅ Withdraw half — you're break-even.
✅ Leave the rest in the coin — catch a life-changing trade at 10x, 20x, maybe 100x or 1000x.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📊 WHICH ONE SHOULD YOU CHOOSE?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 Deposit 1–3 SOL → work with 100% profit / 30% stop-loss. Withdraw everything at once.
🔹 Deposit 5 SOL or more → withdraw part, leave part in the coin and wait for a life-changing trade.
For example: left $20 — they could turn into **$20,000**.

The choice of strategy is yours.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔍 WHICH SIGNAL TO TAKE AND WHICH TO SKIP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When you click through the signal to the chart — also open FOMO.
There you can see:
✅ Which experienced and profitable traders are buying
✅ What they're saying about this coin

This is also visible on AXIOM and GMGN — next to the chart there's a chat where people talk.

How to tell a coin is good:
🔥 Lively discussion
🔥 There's news, hype
🔥 Active holders

When it's better to skip a signal:
❌ The coin isn't hype
❌ Holders aren't talking
❌ No news

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ IMPORTANT POINT ABOUT ENTRY PRICE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you click through the signal and see that the price has already run up from the signal price — don't rush to buy.

Better to wait for a small pullback. Don't buy at highs.

But if you see lively discussion and the coin is growing before your eyes — you need to be quick, because it can fly up tens of times in a minute.

It all comes with experience. Nothing complicated.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📈 IMPORTANT: SIGNAL QUANTITY AND QUALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Many people ask: how many signals will there be, and how reliable are they?

On quantity — it all depends on market activity:
🔹 The bot can drop 3–5 signals per hour
🔹 Or just 1–2 signals in 2 hours

You can't predict it. That's the market.

On quality — here's the thing:
✅ The win rate never drops below 50–55%, and often it's higher
✅ With the Take-Profit 100% / Stop-Loss 30% strategy, you'll always be in profit
✅ Even if the win rate drops to 45–50% on some day — that's absolutely fine

Believe me, I haven't come across groups with this level of signal quality. And where there are somewhat similar ones — the price is $700–1000 per month just to be in the group.

That's how it is. 😉

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🤖 ABOUT AUTOMATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Right now I'm looking for a decent platform to automate the process:
👉 A contract appears in the signal group → the bot buys the coin automatically → and sells according to the loaded settings (take-profit, stop-loss).

I found three platforms, considering which one is better. I'll tell you about it later. Not everything at once.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Guys, there's nothing complicated. Go for it — you'll succeed.

🚀 And everyone will catch their life-changing trade. Wishing everyone profits!
